questions.question: Which two digits should be interchanged to make the given equation correct? 32 ÷ 6 + 26 – 13 × 6 = 54
questions.questionHtml:
Which two digits should be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

32 ÷ 6 + 26 – 13 × 6 = 54
questions.solution:
1) 2 and 3

Given equation: 32 ÷ 6 + 26 – 13 × 6 = 54

After interchanging ‘2 and 3’, we get:

L.H.S = 23 ÷ 6 + 36 – 12 × 6

= 3.8 + 36 – 72

= 39.8 – 72

= -32.2 ≠ R.H.S

2) 3 and 6

Given equation: 32 ÷ 6 + 26 – 13 × 6 = 54

After interchanging ‘3 and 6’, we get:

L.H.S = 62 ÷ 3 + 23 – 16 × 3

= 20.6 + 23 – 48

= 43.6 – 48

= - 4.4 ≠ R.H.S

3) 3 and 1

Given equation: 32 ÷ 6 + 26 – 13 × 6 = 54

After interchanging ‘3 and 1’, we get:

L.H.S = 12 ÷ 6 + 26 – 31 × 6

= 2 + 26 – 186

= 28 – 186

= = 158 ≠ R.H.S

4) 6 and 2

Given equation: 32 ÷ 6 + 26 – 13 × 6 = 54

After interchanging ‘6 and 2’, we get:

L.H.S = 36 ÷ 2 + 62 – 13 × 2

= 18 + 62 – 26

= 80 – 26

= 54 = R.H.S

Hence, ‘6 and 2’ is the correct answer.

questions.question: Product A is costlier than product B by Rs. 2. If the price of product A is increased by two times the price of product B. the new price of product A become Rs. 17. What is the price of product B?

Product A is costlier than product B by Rs. 2.

A - B = 2

Or, A = 2 + B      ----(i)

If the price of product A is increased by two times the price of product B, the new price of product A become Rs. 17.

According to statement:

A + 2B = 17

2 + B + 2B = 17 [Substituting the value of A from (i)]

3B = 17 – 2

3B = 15

B = 5

Hence, the price of product B is Rs. 5.

questions.question: Who chaired the sixth meeting of the Island Development Agency in New Delhi in January 2020?
questions.questionHtml: Who chaired the sixth meeting of the Island Development Agency in New Delhi in January 2020?
questions.solution:
Option 4 is the correct answer. Union Home Minister Amit Shah chaired the 6th meeting of Island Development Agency.

  • This meeting was held in New Delhi in January 2020.
  • The meeting was attended by Lt. Governor of Andaman & Nicobar, Administrator of Lakshadweep, the Cabinet Secretary, CEO of NITI Aayog and secretary and officials from various Ministries.
  • Outcomes:
    • Plans for tourism promotion, the export of seafood and coconut-based products have been taken up.
    • Development of Land and Water-based tourism to be boosted.
    • Digitally connecting will be improved in the islands of the two Archipelago through submarine Optical Fibre Cables.
    • Improvement of air and sea connectivity has been proposed along with airports at Greater Nicobar and Minicoy Islands.
  • Island Development Agency was established on June 1, 2017, to undertake island development.

Andaman and Nicobar islands: 

  • These islands are a seaward extension of Arakan- Yoma Mountains of Myanmar.
  • The Andaman group consists of North Andaman, Middle Andaman, South Andaman & Little Andaman and the Nicobar group consists of Car Nicobar, the Little Nicobar, and the Great Nicobar.
  • The capital city Port Blair is situated in the South Andaman.
  • 10º Channel separates the Andaman islands from Nicobar.
  • The Barren Island, India's only active volcano is in the Middle Andaman and Narcondam is also a volcanic island.
  • Saddle Peak is the highest point of this Archipelago.
  • Indira Point, India's southernmost tip is part of Greater Nicobar.
  • Andaman and Nicobar islands are one of the biodiversity hotspots of India.

Lakshadweep Islands:

  • This archipelago consists of 36 islands and atolls that are of Coral origin.
  • The capital of Lakshadweep is Kavaratti.
  • These were earlier known as Laccadive, Minicoy and Amindivi Islands.
  • Andrott is the largest island of this group.
  • Lakshadweep islands are separated from the Maldives by 8º Channel.

questions.question: The development of a fruit without fertilization is called ______.
questions.questionHtml: The development of a fruit without fertilization is called ______.
questions.solution:
Option 2 is the correct answer: The development of a fruit without fertilization is called Parthenocarpy.

  • During normal fruit development, the pollens from stamen reach the stigma and then travels down to ovary where pollen and ovule combine to form an embryo.
  • The embryo then grows into a zygote and then into seed and then fruit development starts.
  • But when the fruit production is brought about without fertilisation (naturally or artificially), it is called Parthenocarpy.

questions.question: In which period was the legendary Victoria Terminus station (currently Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus), Mumbai built?
questions.questionHtml: In which period was the legendary Victoria Terminus station (currently Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus), Mumbai built?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 1878 to 1887.

Key Points

  • Victoria Terminus station, Mumbai, now known as Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus, was built from 1878 to 1887.
  • The construction of Victoria terminus was started in 1878 to establish a new railway station in the place of old Bori Bunder railway station.
  • The design was prepared by British born architectural engineer Frederick William Stevens in rich Italian Gothic Style.
  • The terminus was named after Queen Victoria, who completed 50 years as a monarch in 1887.
  • In 1996 the terminus was renamed as Chhatrapati Shivaji terminus to honour Maratha warrior king Shivaji.
  • In May 2017, the word Maharaja was also added and hence known as Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus.
  • The terminus is the headquarters of India's Central Railway. 

Additional Information

  • The railways were introduced in India in 1853 during the tenure of Lord Dalhousie.
  • The first railway line was laid from Bombay (now Mumbai) to Thane.
  • Mumbai is also known as The City of Seven Islands.
  •  Bombay  was gifted by the Portuguese to King Charles II of Britain as dowry after he married Princess Catherine in1661.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a nationalised bank?

  • This major financial step was taken up to reform the lending sector and provide credit to some priority sectors like agriculture and small scale businesses.
  • Then in 1980, another 6 banks were nationalized.

 State Bank of India:

income of A is 60% less than that of B

expenditure of A is equal to 60% of B’s expenditure

questions.question: If the 6–digit numbers x35624 and 1257y4 are divisible by 11 and 72, respectively, then what is the value of (5x – 2y)?
questions.questionHtml: If the 6–digit numbers x35624 and 1257y4 are divisible by 11 and 72, respectively, then what is the value of (5x – 2y)?
questions.solution:
Concept used:

Divisibility law of 11: If the difference of the alternating sum of digits of the number is a multiple of 11 (e.g. 2343 is divisible by 11 because 2 – 3 + 4 – 3 = 0, which is a multiple of 11).

Divisibility law of 8 ⇒ A number is divisible by 8 if the number formed by its last three digits is divisible by 8

Divisibility law of 9 ⇒ A number is divisible by 9 if the sum of its digits is divisible by 9.

Calculation:

The 6–digit numbers x35624 is divisible by 11, then

⇒ x – 3 + 5 – 6 + 2 – 4 = 0

⇒ x + 7 – 13 = 0

⇒ x = 6

The 6–digit number 1257y4 is divisible by 72, so we can say that the number is also divisible by 8 and 9, then

⇒ 1 + 2 + 5 + 7 + y + 4

⇒ 19 + y

If we put y = 8, then the number becomes 27 which is divisible by 9.

⇒ 5x – 2y

⇒ 5 × 6 – 2 × 8

⇒ 30 – 16

⇒ 14

The answer is 14.

questions.question: The difference in compound interest on a certain sum at 10% p.a. for one year, when the interest is compounded half-yearly and yearly, is Rs. 88.80. What is the simple interest on the same sum for \(1\frac{2}{3}\) years at the same rate?
questions.questionHtml: The difference in compound interest on a certain sum at 10% p.a. for one year, when the interest is compounded half-yearly and yearly, is Rs. 88.80. What is the simple interest on the same sum for \(1\frac{2}{3}\) years at the same rate?
questions.solution:
Shortcut Trick

Difference in effective interest rate for 1 year = (5 × 5) / 100 = 0.25%.

0.25% of Sum = Rs. 88.80 ⇒ 100% of Sum (Principal) = 88.80 × 400 = Rs. 35,520.

Simple Interest for 12/3 (or 5/3) years = (35,520 × 10 × 5/3) / 100.

Required SI = 35,520 ÷ 6 = Rs. 5,920.

∴ The correct answer is Rs. 5,920.

Alternate Method

Given: Rate (R) = 10% p.a., Time (T) = 1 year, Difference in CI = Rs. 88.80.

Formula Used: CI = P[(1 + r/n)nt − 1]; SI = (P × R × T) / 100.

⇒ Case 1 (Yearly): CI1 = P × 10% = 0.10P

⇒ Case 2 (Half-yearly): Rate = 5%, Periods = 2; CI2 = P[(1 + 0.05)2 − 1] = 0.1025P

⇒ Difference = 0.1025P − 0.10P = 0.0025P

⇒ 0.0025P = 88.80 ⇒ P = 88.80 / 0.0025 = 35,520

⇒ For SI: T = 5/3 years, R = 10%

⇒ SI = (35,520 × 10 × 5/3) ÷ 100 = 35,520 × 50 ÷ 300

⇒ SI = 35,520 ÷ 6 = 5,920

∴ The correct answer is Rs. 5,920.

Additional Information

Half-Yearly Compounding

When interest is compounded half-yearly, the annual rate is divided by 2 (R' = R/2) and the time is multiplied by 2 (n = 2T).

Difference for Two Periods

The difference between CI and SI for two periods is given by P × (R/100)2, where R is the rate per period.

Effective Rate Method

For two successive changes of a% and b%, the effective change is (a + b + ab/100)%. This is useful for Compound Interest calculations.

  • A sentence cannot start with a pronoun. It must refer back to the noun of the sentence. Eg: The team won the match. They were given cash prize and medals.
    'They' here refers to 'the team'. Thus options A, B & D are ruled out.
  • The Indian Government is introduced as the subject. Thus C forms the beginning.
  • B follows C. In reference to the facilities announced in sentence A, one of them is that the Indian government will import technologically advanced medical instruments.
  • A follows B and states that the technologically advanced medical instruments can be purchased on subsidized rates with loan facilities.
  • D follows A. When the instruments are purchased on subsidized rates with loan facilities, it will strengthen the economic conditions of entrepreneurs.
  • Thus the correct order is CBAD.

questions.question: Given below are four jumbled sentences. Out of the given options pick the one that gives their correct order. A. This is because of its aroma, flavour, and variety in the market. B. Thus, it leads to poor health and mental disorders among children. C. Children, as well as teenagers, are tempted towards junk food. D. It has no or negligible nutritional value and high content of sugar and salt.
questions.questionHtml:
Given below are four jumbled sentences. Out of the given options pick the one that gives their correct order.

A. This is because of its aroma, flavour, and variety in the market.

B. Thus, it leads to poor health and mental disorders among children.

C. Children, as well as teenagers, are tempted towards junk food.

D. It has no or negligible nutritional value and high content of sugar and salt.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Option 2.

When we connect and frame the sentences, it is important to establish a connection between them.

  • A sentence cannot start with a determiner. It must have a noun to refer back to. Eg: *This shop is closed.
    The meaning can be understood in the context. However, the beginning of the sentence is incomplete.
    Thus, A is ruled out.
  • Words like thus, to sum up, hence are concluding words. They mark the end of the idea. Thus B is also ruled out.
  • A sentence cannot start with a pronoun. It refers back to the pronoun. An indefinite pronoun at the beginning of the sentence does not convey the actual meaning of the story, paragraph, idea. Thus D is ruled out.
  • The remaining option thus is C. It is an introduction to the paragraph with the subject 'children as well as teenagers.'
  • A follows C. It connects with A stating that they are attracted towards junk food because of its aroma, flavour.
  • D follows next. It states that junk food has negligible nutritional value and high content of sugar and salt.
  • As a concluding statement, B follows. It tells that because of negligible nutritional value it leads to poor health and mental disorders among children.

Thus the correct order is CADB.

Children, as well as teenagers, are tempted towards junk food. This is because of its aroma, flavour, and variety in the market. It has no or negligible nutritional value and high content of sugar and salt. Thus, it leads to poor health and mental disorders among children.

questions.question: Select the correct passive form of the given sentence. His elder sister taught him English.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.

His elder sister taught him English.

options.text: He has been taught English by his elder sister.
options.html: He has been taught English by his elder sister.

options.text: He is being taught English by his elder sister.
options.html: He is being taught English by his elder sister.

options.text: He was taught English by his elder sister.
options.html: He was taught English by his elder sister.

options.text: His elder sister is taught English by him.
options.html: His elder sister is taught English by him.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is Option 3.

The given sentence is in Active Voice. Its structure is: Subject + V + Indirect object + Direct object.

It needs to be changed into Passive Voice. Its structure will be: Indirect Object + was + V3 + Direct Object + by + Subject.

The tense of the active voice is in Simple Past. When it undergoes change in Passive Voice, auxiliary was is added.

The verbs 'taught' here takes both a direct and an indirect object in the Active Voice and the indirect object becomes the subject of the passive voice.
